method: Editorial series concepts informed by a vidIQ snapshot, one reference breakdown, and cited 2026 forecast sources. These are hypotheses to test, not a ranked viral list or a promise of views.
channelData: BB channel was not connected to vidIQ at review time; no audience-specific performance claim is possible.

series.name: The Crave Lab
series.hookPattern: finished texture first, then reveal how it was made
series.storyRule: Start with an edible payoff, reverse to preparation, end with a distinct bite or tear. Show one ingredient changing state in every middle shot.
series.visualRule: Macro food action, real contact between hands and tools, motivated pushes only; keep one hero dish and physical continuity.
series.soundRule: Natural kitchen ASMR leads: crust, knife, pan, spread, tear. No voice or captions unless a factual explanation is essential. Music is optional and must be licensed.
evidence: vidIQ breakdown of https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LV3mChwupF8: five scenes over about 20 seconds; no voice or background music reported
vidIQ garlic-bread outlier snapshot on 2026-11-15 found multiple short cheese/garlic-bread examples with strong channel-relative performance; this does not predict BB performance

series.name: One Pan, One Transformation
series.hookPattern: raw ingredient enters the pan with an obvious question
series.storyRule: Pose a visible culinary problem, show a technique that changes the ingredient, reveal the final texture. No unrelated insert shots.
series.visualRule: One pan and one stable orientation; use heat, steam, glaze, and hand action as actual motion.
series.soundRule: Sizzle and utensil contact carry cuts; one brief voice line only if technique cannot be shown clearly.
evidence: Pinterest Predicts 2026 Cabbage Crush and Whole Foods Market 2026 vinegar and freezer forecasts are broad signals, not proof for these exact recipes

series.name: Honest Luxury Levels
series.hookPattern: same dish, one visible upgrade at each price step
series.storyRule: Each level must add an ingredient and visible cooking or plating action. Show a sourced ingredient basket, not a restaurant menu price.
series.visualRule: Lock plate angle and serving size across levels so the visual difference is legible.
series.soundRule: Use a distinct real kitchen sound for each upgrade; duck optional licensed music under it.
evidence: Original app format. No vidIQ evidence currently establishes this format as trending for BB.

series.name: Guess the Basket
series.hookPattern: show finished plate, ask for the sourced ingredient basket total
series.storyRule: Reveal ingredients one by one; give viewers a fair visual clue before the sourced basket total. Never imply the total is a menu price.
series.visualRule: Close product inserts and a final wide plate; use an unambiguous readable counter.
series.soundRule: Quiet tactile sounds with a restrained reveal sting; captions only for the numeric question and answer.
evidence: Original app format; performance and preferred hook timing require BB upload data.

series.name: Tiny Technique, Big Result
series.hookPattern: show a food failure, then one small correction
series.storyRule: One practical technique with an observable before/after; verify factual cooking claims before narration. Avoid inventing a result the video cannot show.
series.visualRule: Locked comparison framing, one overhead demonstration, macro final texture; warm realistic grade.
series.soundRule: Short natural voice only when it adds instruction, otherwise text labels and process sound. Keep captions aligned to spoken words.
evidence: TikTok Next 2026 mentions #cookinghacks as a broad discovery signal; no specific technique here is a measured trend.

series.name: Close-Up Recipe Guide
series.hookPattern: finished spoonful then clear ingredient-by-ingredient rewind
series.storyRule: Show one hero dish in one vessel. Each close-up advances the recipe with a visible ingredient or cooking state. Put usable quantities and a complete method in the pack; end with the cooked dish served.
series.visualRule: Stable pan and countertop orientation, same hands and tools, macro focus on each ingredient entering the same dish. Keep the food state and ingredient count continuous. Cut across real cooking time; never imply raw food instantly cooks.
series.soundRule: Kokoro voice and aligned subtitles for ingredient amounts and instructions, with low, action-matched recorded kitchen sound. Music only when licensed and useful.
evidence: Marion’s Kitchen one-pan red curry dumplings provides a recipe reference, not proof of an upload trend
